messages:
tara: FYI sample-app release job failed after the latest typegen regen landed on main.

ben: saw the report. Quick glance shows mismatch in SDK runtime vs generated types for Auth config.

ci-bot: pipeline 5264 failed at job 'release/integration:sample-app'.

ci-bot: ```
Error: Missing required field 'backoffMs' in AuthRetryOptions
    at validateAuthRetry (/workspace/sdk/lib/auth.js:34:13)
    at startApp (/workspace/sample-app/server/index.js:9:5)
```

typegen-bot: regen diff: packages/typegen/out/auth.d.ts updated. Changes: AuthRetryOptions removed deprecated 'backoffMs' and introduced 'backoff' (object with unit). Marked as "non-breaking" by auto-labeler.

tara: that rename is breaking for runtime consumers — it changed shape. Why was it labeled non-breaking?

ben: the changelog/semver pipeline decided based on commit type 'chore(typegen): normalize shapes' and skipped bumping semver. Our rules treat typegen-only as doc changes.

kai: the problem is the typegen normalizer made a shape change (flatten -> object) which isn't innocuous. We need better detection.

lin: immediate mitigation: publish a patch that adds a compatibility layer in runtime accepting both backoffMs (number) and backoff (object). I'll prepare a small shim.

tara: good. But longer term we should: 1) make the changelog generator flag any typegen diff that alters exported type names/structures, 2) run sample-app smoke test in CI against the new generated types before merging, 3) require manual review for typegen commits that touch public API.

ben: +1. Also add a unit test that compares serialized public API shapes before and after regen and fails CI if there's an incompatible change unless reviewer overrides.

typegen-bot: suggested local repro: `yarn workspace @redwood/typegen run regen && node ./scripts/verify-public-shapes.js`

lin: draft shim I tested locally:

```js
// packages/sdk/src/auth/compat.js
function normalizeBackoff(opts) {
  if (opts.backoff !== undefined) return opts;
  if (opts.backoffMs !== undefined) {
    opts.backoff = { unit: 'ms', value: opts.backoffMs };
    delete opts.backoffMs;
  }
  return opts;
}
module.exports = { normalizeBackoff };
```

kai: please open PR with that shim + changelog entry and mark it as patch. We'll publish quickly. Also add an integration smoke test that installs the published package to prevent future mismatches.

ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1300. Running CI.

ben: small process improvement: the release-bot should refuse auto-labeling a typegen-only commit as non-breaking if diff includes structural changes (object vs primitive, renamed keys). We can derive that by AST diff of types.

release-bot: noted. Proposal: require a "typegen-impact" check on PRs touching packages/typegen/**. If check reports structural changes, PR must include a semver label (major/minor/patch) and at least one core reviewer approval.

tara: please also add a 'post-release verification' job that installs the published tarball in sample-app and runs smoke tests. This should be run automatically after any sdk publish.

lin: PR CI passed, merging now. Will coordinate immediate patch publish.

ci-bot: publish job queued. Post-publish verification will run once release completes.

ben: created ticket DEVEX-320: "detect structural typegen diffs; enforce semver gating + post-release smoke tests" and assigned to devex.

kai: one more: update typegen README with a short checklist: public types check, run sample-app smoke, semver label rule. I'll add to PR template.

release-bot: package @redwood/sdk@1.8.4 published. Starting post-release verification.

ci-bot: post-release sample-app smoke job passed.

tara: thanks all. Good catch. Let's merge the detection tooling this week so we don't repeat this. :raised_hands:
